metadata.dataset_name: OpenStreetMap Dima Hasao Facilities, Settlements & Bridges
metadata.population_grid_status: No gridded WorldPop/Census raster ingested locally; only explicit OSM population tags are retained (null where absent — population exposure counts are never fabricated).
metadata.limitations: OpenStreetMap coverage in rural Northeast India is volunteer-contributed and incomplete for small hamlets, primary health sub-centres, and rural schools. Exposure estimates represent minimum mapped asset proximity, NOT complete census or damage counts.
